name: TrustedVolumes RFQ permissionless signer registration and taker-funded fills
summary: TrustedVolumes' RFQ module let anyone call registerAllowedOrderSigner, and its fill path pulled the sell-side tokens from the order's taker field without that party's consent. The attacker registered its own EOA as signer, signed orders naming the inventory wallet 0x9ba0cf15 as taker, and filled them for 1 wei of USDC each, spending the wallet's approvals.
notes: The module router last repointed the exploited selectors 0x4112e1c2 and 0xea7faa61 to this module in consecutive txs; the later one is the reset. Later module-selection events changed other selectors only.

A separate defect from the 1inch Fusion v1 Settlement incident (eip155:1:0x62734ce8…, 2025), whose campaign drained TrustedVolumes through Settlement and contains none of these txs. Campaign: three copycat signers (five txs) and one MEV bot draining residual approvals within six hours.
